Horrible experience! overrated!
Sep 2019
Horrible experience! overrated!
I went to this place traveling for 25mins at around 2pm and they said it was their lunch hour and wouldn't serve until 5pm. they should have mentioned it in Google that they wouldn't be serving during those hours. so I went away and roamed around tried different food. 
I came back at 5:30pm. In the menu it is written one pancake for 22,000vnd. when i tried to order, the server said i have to order three. why should I do that? I just wanted to taste one so I asked if I could first try one and then order more of required as I was already quite full. he rudely said "no no". then I had to order 3 pancakes for 66,000vnd. then he asked if I wanted to have a drink and I said no. he made a face showing how irritated he was! that was so unprofessional.
it was really hot inside the restaurant so I asked if I could change my seat and sit near the fan. he said I wasn't allowed to change my seat. I was like whattt??? 
I had a horrible time given how they behaved. and then the food arrived which looked nothing like the picture in their menu. on top of that, I had to make my own. and it eventually was a rice paper for roll. it was nothing like the pancake i saw online. I was upset how they behaved and such a disaster of food.
Will not recommend this place. complete waste of time and money! Horrible service!

reviews.review_text:
Cherilyn C
8 contributions
0
Bad quality food and overpriced!
Jul 2019 • Couples
We stopped for some banh xeo after seeing great reviews for this place. We have lived in Hanoi for 6 months and have travelled through Vietnam and I can tell you that the quality of the food served here in not good at all.

The banh xeo was not cooked fresh, it was merely reheated. It is also very expensive, they charge 22k for one tiny pancake. You should be getting at least 3 for 22k. 

The pancake did not include turmeric which normally gives it its signature yellow colour.

We also had nem (Hanoi spring rolls) which were also tiny and very very greasy. 

When we got the bill they had added a fee for the hand towels they gave us and we were also charged for the iced tea (which is normally free in most restaurants in Hanoi), both of which the owner never told us the price for when he gave us them. 

I would not recommend this place!
